text:
marco: quick check — I'm assembling the sprint relnotes for v0.11. Can we lock down the final bullet list and any known-issue callouts before EOD?

alisha: sending my list now. main items: adaptive routing beta, SDK snippet changes for streaming, and the cache TTL change that can break some long-context LLMs.

marco: got it — add the adaptive routing opt-in under "how to enable" with the flag example. also we should note the fallback policy behavior change (will now prefer cheaper variants for background jobs).

devon: FYI, docs PR #4125 updates the SDK snippets for streaming. It replaced `client.stream()` with `client.generate_stream()` — there are a couple of sample pages that still use the old call (examples/streaming-basic.md and quickstarts/python-chat.md).

kat: I pushed quick fixes in my fork. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4180 : I changed the snippet and added a short note about chunked payloads.

marco: thanks kat. Can you also add a short blurb under Known issues: "Streaming SDK v0.9.x: intermittent truncation when the client uses small chunk sizes — workaround: increase `chunk_size` to >= 1024 or pin to v0.10.x"

kat: done in PR 4180 comment — left the exact wording to you, marco, for release voice.

devon: also discovered an edge where the migration guide for dedicated -> private omitted `kvs_cache` config. I added a one-liner to migration-guides/dedicated-to-private.md (see snippet):

```
# ensure kvs cache is enabled for prefix caching
kvs_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_seconds: 3600
```

alisha: good catch. That should be a small migration note under Tips. Add that to the relnotes as a "migration note" bullet.

marco: draft bullets I have so far: - Adaptive routing (beta, opt-in) w/ example flag; - SDK streaming API rename and workaround for v0.9.x; - Cache TTL default change impacting long-context workloads; - Migration note about kvs_cache for Dedicated->Private; - Minor link fixes and sample cleanup.

release-bot: deploy scheduled: docs-staging -> prod at 2026-03-22T22:00Z if all checks pass :rocket:

docs-ci: build passed for PRs 4180, 4191, 4179. One lint warning: broken link in examples/embeddings-quickstart.md -> /sdk/py/embeddings (404).

kat: I'll fix that link in a follow-up patch.

marco: okay timeline: merge snippet fixes (4180) + link patch before 20:30Z, freeze for copy edits until 21:15Z, publish after release-bot window. I'll craft the Known issues paragraph and ping legal for the compliance blurb.

alisha: do we want a short "what changed for engineers" section that lists config keys and example diffs? I can assemble a tiny diff block.

marco: yes — short diffs are high signal. Put them under "For engineers" with 1-2 inline code examples. Keep audience-focused.

devon: one more: examples/quantization.md still references `q4_0` model family by name; models team recommended using abstract family names in docs. I'll swap that to `--model-family gpt-small-quant` in my PR 4191.

marco: perfect. If nothing else, I'll publish the relnotes draft in the docs PR and ping this channel for last-minute nits. Thanks all — I'll post the final relnotes link here when it's live. :tada:
